subject.title: fix(gateway): add separate inline avatar size cap for agents.list projection

question: Should accepted avatars above the smaller gateway projection limit remain visible through thumbnailing or lazy loading, or may gateway identity surfaces omit them?
rationale: The current public behavior displays accepted avatars, while this PR deliberately makes larger existing avatars disappear; source and tests cannot determine whether that compatibility tradeoff is intended product behavior.

options.title: Preserve avatar visibility
options.body: Require thumbnailing or a lazy avatar reference so accepted large avatars remain visible without inflating agents.list.

options.title: Approve bounded omission
options.body: Allow avatars above the projection threshold to be omitted, with explicit fallback coverage and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep existing projection behavior
options.body: Decline the smaller projection limit and retain the current payload behavior until a visibility-preserving design exists.

recommendation.title: Preserve avatar visibility
recommendation.body: Require thumbnailing or a lazy avatar reference so accepted large avatars remain visible without inflating agents.list.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current canonical avatar projection implementation and is the strongest available owner for its compatibility and product behavior.
